sprint: THE ALPHA SPRINT — Phase 4 (the security pass, recorded end-to-end)

keyHandling.wizardToEnv: masked paste (read -s, never echoed) → appended to .env → chmod 600 immediately (asserted per paste AND at exit)
keyHandling.envToTransport: keys read server-side from env only (AskProvider.fromEnv / DefiLlama.route); they ride ONLY the provider transport (Authorization header / x-api-key / URL param to the chosen provider) — never a prompt, a page, a bundle, or a recorded string (the pro route's RECORDED source uses the redacted <key> form)
keyHandling.validationCalls: script/validate-key.ts — one minimal auth-shaped call; adapters throw status-only messages by design; output additionally scrubbed
keyHandling.scrubber: src/util/scrub.ts on every doctor/validate/phrase-error output path — tested with SEEDED keys across the paths (security_pass wall, positive-controlled)
keyHandling.residualNamed: the Gemini key rides its request URL (provider API shape); a transport-level error message could embed that URL — the phrase-path reason is now SCRUBBED before render (AH3 closed by design, not arithmetic)

injectionUnderProfiles: the five voice walls + the groundedness gate + the advice wall run IN THE BATTERY with mock providers (hostile outputs seeded); the capability layer adds NO new model-input path (descriptors change caps/urls, not prompts); the parity differential (S48) proves the verdict surface is profile-invariant, so a paid-profile injection cannot reach a verdict by construction; the gates' source is capability-blind (asserted)

dependencyAudit.verdict: the mass-path dep set is unchanged; no new runtime dependency was added by this sprint (the wizard is shell + Bun stdlib)

skillIsolation: skill/ = SKILL.md docs only; .impeccable/ = committed config.json + gitignored dev ephemera; no runtime import from either on any served path (grep-verified in the Phase-1 audit; unchanged since)

servedHardening.bind: 127.0.0.1 default on BOTH servers (HOST env = explicit opt-in) — AB1
servedHardening.headers: nosniff · X-Frame-Options DENY · referrer-policy no-referrer · CSP (self + inline styles/scripts for the server-rendered pages, frame-ancestors none) on every response of both servers — AH1
servedHardening.rateLimits: :4444 → 240/min general · /refresh 6/min · /ask 30/min per caller (AB2); :4319 → the carried 120/min + console 20/min + 64KiB body cap
servedHardening.auth: STUDIO_TOKEN Bearer on the studio's mutating routes, now CONSTANT-TIME compared (AH2); unset token = open ON LOCALHOST ONLY (the bind fix makes the old assumption true); ALPHA.md instructs setting the token before any exposure

secureDefaults: keyless-first · localhost-first · SAMPLE-labeled-first · refuse-over-red launch gate · no telemetry (none exists — grep-clean) · nothing signs
updateStory: --version = package version + git sha + PINS_SHA (truthful, from the tree); ALPHA.md carries the update paragraph (git pull → setup → verify)
